episodeTitle.en: Inside OpenAI: 2026 is the year of agents, AI’s biggest bottleneck, and why compute isn’t the issue
episodeTitle.zh: OpenAI内部视角：2026年是智能体之年，AI的最大瓶颈，以及为何计算资源不是问题

guestBioOfficial.en: Alexander Embiricos leads product on Codex, OpenAI’s powerful coding agent, which has grown 20x since August and now serves trillions of tokens weekly. Before joining OpenAI, Alexander spent five years building a pair programming product for engineers. He now works at the frontier of AI-led software development, building what he describes as a software engineering teammate—an AI agent designed to participate across the entire development lifecycle. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 亚历山大·恩比里科斯（Alexander Embiricos）负责OpenAI强大编码智能体Codex的产品，该产品自8月以来已增长20倍，目前每周处理数万亿个令牌。在加入OpenAI之前，亚历山大花了五年时间为工程师开发对程式设计的支持产品。如今，他在AI主导的软件开发前沿工作，打造了他所描述的软件工程团队伙伴——一个旨在参与整个开发生命周期的AI智能体。*我们将探讨：*

title.en: Inside OpenAI: 2026 is the year of agents, AI’s biggest bottleneck, and why compute isn’t the issue
title.zh: OpenAI内部视角：2026年是智能体之年，AI的最大瓶颈，以及为何计算资源不是问题

summary.en: Alex explains how Codex functions like a very smart intern that can be put on call for its own training and even writes much of the infrastructure code behind its training runs. He shares a striking example: the Sora Android app was built in 18 days and publicly launched 10 days later, becoming the number-one app in the store. The conversation covers OpenAI's goal of making Codex proactive, why writing code is the best way for models to use computers, and how the product team uses user feedback from Reddit to keep improving.
summary.zh: Alex 解释了 Codex 如何像一个非常聪明的实习生，可以被安排去“值班”维护自己的训练，甚至编写其训练运行背后的大量基础设施代码。他分享了一个惊人案例：Sora 的安卓应用仅用 18 天构建、10 天后公开发布，并成为应用商店排名第一的应用。对话还涵盖 OpenAI 让 Codex 变得“主动”的目标、为何代码是模型使用计算机的最佳方式，以及产品团队如何利用 Reddit 上的用户反馈持续改进。
